how_to_edit: shape is thread or channel. decisions lists what a good reader should find: 'what' is for humans, 'quotes' are exact words any of which count as the evidence. An empty list means nothing was decided. open_question is true if an important question is left unsettled. holdout conversations are never used to tune the prompt. Add your own at the end, and set author to who wrote it.
